about: The example of level 4 (docs/level-4.md): a drawing board, painted on the frame at every frame. Shift and the metronome key show and close its page in any mode; the blue knob moves a cross left and right and the second knob up and down, each move drawing a line; the red knob's press wipes the board and deletes its file; the third knob's press shows the board on the base's blank page and back. The title is centred and measured. It keeps the board in sketch.bin, in a folder of its own shown in the disk mode. It changes no place of the firmware and needs the base. tools/build_all.py builds it into out/examples/.
name: sketch
